family: The one total certificate-prefix language defined by the deterministic evaluator in proof.md. At actual input length N=0 output 0. Otherwise choose B as the least positive integer with B^5>32*N^3 and k as the least prime at least B; if k>=N output 0. Put m=N-k, r=ceil(m/k), t=ceil(sqrt(r)); output 0 if t>=r or k*t<r*(r+1). Read the first k input bits as the lower coefficients of a monic degree-k polynomial Q over F_2; output 0 unless Z^(2^k)=Z modulo Q and gcd(Q,Z^2+Z)=1. Zero-pad the remaining m bits into r field elements a_i of F_2[Z]/Q, constant coefficient first in each block. Output the constant coefficient of the order-t elementary symmetric polynomial in a_i^(2^(r+2-i)-1), for i=1,...,r. All prefix bits are part of N; Q is input, not advice.
theorem: This fixed total language is in P and hence in NP with the empty-witness verifier in proof.md. In the pinned full B2 model, for every sufficiently large integer actual input length N, C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-O(N^(4/5)), and therefore liminf over all integer N tending to infinity of C_B2(F_N)/N>=4. The family and verifier are fixed independently of all asymptotic thresholds.
